Video of the unit being hand-turned or bench-tested for rotation smoothness
Close-up of torque converter seal/hub area for leak signs
Photo of fluid level/condition via dipstick or drain plug

response.reason: Item type (transmission assembly with torque converter) is confirmed by the witness, but completeness, internal condition, and the M272 designation are all unverified or unverifiable remotely, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
